data.fiscalperiodpolicytextblock: Annual closing dateThe Company follows the concept of a fiscal year, which ends on the Sunday nearest to the end of the month of December. Normally each fiscal year consists of 52 weeks, but every five or six years the fiscal year consists of 53 weeks, and therefore includes additional shipping days, as was the case in fiscal year 2020, and will be the case again in fiscal year 2026.
data.estimatedusefullivesofassetstabletextblo: Property, plant and equipment are stated at cost. The Company utilizes the straight-line method of depreciation over the estimated useful lives of the assets:Building and building equipment30 yearsLand and leasehold improvements10 - 20 yearsMachinery and equipment2 - 13 years
